situation: A GitLab Free project whose board block names only `status::in-progress`, `status::blocked` and `status::done`. One card is in progress, none is blocked, eight open issues carry no status label, and one open issue still carries `status::done`.
expected_guard: with no to-do label, the Open list is the queue, in board order, and no card is reported uncolumned; one drift line names the open issue carrying `status::done` and `phil:groom-issues` as what acts on it
must_not: report the eight Open-list cards as uncolumned while they are the queue
say the queued section is empty
send `glab api` anything but a GET
why_this_fixture_exists: A GitLab board's Open list is its backlog where the family names no to-do label; reading it as uncolumned would report the whole queue as a defect. A done label on an open issue is GitLab's form of an open card in Done.
